verdict.rationale: Extend's docs say every processing endpoint, including parse, supports an asynchronous mode. The async processing guide covers SDK polling helpers and webhooks for production workloads, and webhooks are registrable via the dashboard or the API with global and workflow-specific subscriptions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parse-specific completion webhook events and payloads, details of the status-polling endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks

citations.quote: Every processing endpoint in Extend (extract, classify, split, parse, and edit) supports both a synchronous and asynchronous mode.
